trainedOn.note: Chess.com NAG references are development labels only and are never read by runtime analysis.

definitions.beforeWin: mover win percentage before the move
definitions.afterWin: mover win percentage after the move
definitions.is_top: 1 when played move matches frozen Stockfish bestMove, else 0
definitions.legal: legal move count before the move
definitions.mateBeforeWin: 1 if mover had a forced mate before the move, else 0
definitions.mateAfterLose: 1 if mover is getting mated after the move, else 0

great.note: Conservative V0.3.2 gate because the current calibration corpus contains only one exact Great reference.

brilliant.note: Brilliant remains the existing sound-sacrifice rule until the corpus contains exact Brilliant examples.
